name: Intuition grants a 25% critical damage bonus aura on all schools (#3686)
contract: Intuition 807589 carries SPELL_AURA_MOD_CRIT_DAMAGE_BONUS (163) with EffectMiscValue school mask 127 (all schools) and EffectBasePoints 24, resolving to 25 with DieSides 1. This aura type is consumed natively by Unit::SpellCriticalDamageBonus and Unit::MeleeDamageBonusDone via GetTotalAuraModifierByMiscMask(SPELL_AURA_MOD_CRIT_DAMAGE_BONUS, schoolMask) (Unit.cpp), generic core machinery not specific to this class.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Intuition is not applied without learning it
Intuition self-applies its aura once learned
Intuition's critical damage bonus effect resolves to 25
